[About]{.about-label}

I am a professor of instructional technology and department chair at Georgia Southern University. My research focuses on how people learn with and through technology — with particular emphasis on motivation, interest development, and the design of technology-rich learning environments. My work spans game-based learning and online learning design, using experimental, survey, and qualitative methods.
